title: One-line commitments — weekly check-ins
content:
Purpose: a minimal weekly scratchpad where I state 1 single commitment sentence for the week, track the small measurable, and capture one retrospective blip. Low friction — if I can write it in one line, I keep momentum.

How I use this (rules):
- Monday morning: write exactly one sentence that describes my ONE most impactful thing this week (the "one-line commitment").
- Add a single measurable (numeric or binary) that I'll check on Friday.
- End of week: one short retrospective sentence (success / blocker / next tiny step).
- If something spills over, convert it to a Linear ticket and paste link in linked_artifacts.

Week buckets (4 weeks) — recent entries:

2026-02-23 → 2026-02-27
One-line commitment: Ship the Console quickstart flow tweak so first-time users finish the tutorial in under 7 minutes.
Metric: median quickstart completion time (baseline ~12m) → target < 7m (measured in analytics cohort A)
Friday retro: Deployed tweak to readme + progress indicator. Completion time dropped to median 8:20. Blocker: missing telemetry for the last screen (need a small event). Next step: add event + validate on Tuesday.

2026-03-02 → 2026-03-06
One-line commitment: Reduce my PR review turnaround to <24h for the product area without blocking releases.
Metric: PRs reviewed within 24h (baseline 55%) → target 85% (track via GH pulse)
Friday retro: Hit 78% this week after morning triage ritual. Biggest time-sink: large design PRs — flagged for async review notes. Action: set 'review sprint' 9–10am M/W/F.

2026-03-09 → 2026-03-13 (current week)
One-line commitment: Draft a lightweight OKR for my personal focus area — "consistency in output" — and share with manager for alignment.
Metric: OKR draft shared + 2 suggested KRs (binary) → target: shared by Wed 3/11
Status mid-week: draft shared in DM, manager requested clearer KR for "impact".

Personal OKR draft (rough) — for discussion with manager:
Objective: Increase weekly reliable output for product improvements and operational hygiene.
KR1: Close 6 production-impacting PRs/month (feature or bugfix) — baseline 3
KR2: Maintain PR review turnaround >80% within 24h each sprint
KR3: Add or update 3 runbooks/docs used by oncall per quarter
Notes: KR1 needs precise scope (what counts as production-impacting?). Ask SRE for input.

Weekly micro-habits (tracking):
- Morning 9–9:30 — triage (blocks = 0) — checkbox each day
- End-of-day 4:30 — 15m single-line summary (forces closure)
- Weekend: 60m learning deep-dive (optional)

Short experiment log (private):
- Experiment: Turned quickstart progress bar orange when >50% of steps completed. Hypothesis: visual progress reduces abandonment.
- Result: measurable drop in dropoff on step 3 (from 14% to 9%) but still above target.

Blockers & questions to resolve:
- Need event on last quickstart step (CONSOLE-87) — blocked on frontend API churn described in linked_artifacts.
- Clarify "production-impacting" with SRE/product — quick sync planned Wed 3/11.
- Is PR review time counted per assignee or per team? (ask eng manager).

Notes-to-self (short):
- If something feels like "busywork", ask: does this move a metric or reduce cognitive load? If no, deprioritize.
- Keep the one-line rule — if it becomes >2 lines, it's probably a project, not a weekly commitment.

Ideas backlog (one-line each, unprioritized):
- Add an "example config" to quickstart so customers can copy/paste and finish in 3 clicks.
- Tiny onboarding analytics dashboard: median by cohort + dropoff funnel.
- PR review template: 3 quick checks to speed async approvals.

Meta reflection (monthly):
- So far the one-line constraint helps me ship smaller, clearer chunks. I need to be ruthless about scope — the biggest wins have been telemetry + microcopy tweaks.
- Next month goal: convert one idea from 'backlog' to shipped each week for 4 weeks.

Last edited notes: shared draft OKR in DM to manager (Maya) on 2026-03-11; she recommended adding a KR around "quality" not just throughput. Will iterate.
